summary: Verified (1) backend admin analytics aggregation refactor and (2) two new Pit Shark workouts added to compound-legs data. 43/43 backend pytest tests passed including all 30 time-series combos (10 metrics x 3 periods), 3 breakdowns, 3 signup-trend periods, 3 chart types, export pagination (limit+skip), profile-posts auth, and non-admin 403 enforcement. Frontend data file additions confirmed via direct file inspection (React Native Expo - no web E2E feasible).

frontend_issues.note: App is React Native Expo. Validated data file structure directly instead of running web E2E. Both new Pit Shark workouts confirmed in /app/frontend/data/compound-legs-workouts-data.ts under 'Pit Shark' equipment block (line ~2008): 'Pit Shark Step-Ups' at line 2216 (intermediate, 14-16 min, 4 rounds 8/leg, Rest 90s) and 'Pit Shark Step-Up Pulses' at line 2343 (advanced, 16-18 min, 4 rounds 6/leg + 3 pulses, Rest 120s). Pit Shark beginner section also has its own 'Pit Shark Step-Ups' variant at line 2089 (3 rounds 8/leg, 75s) - that pre-existed and is unrelated.

critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: All 16 admin analytics endpoints converted from .to_list(10000) to MongoDB aggregation pipelines preserve the documented response shape (metric_type, period, labels, values, secondary_values, total, average).
GOOD: %G-W%V (ISO week) used by MongoDB $dateToString for week period - tested with period=week and labels are returned correctly, no parsing errors.
GOOD: export_users_csv now respects limit (5) and skip (3) query params - paginated payload returned with len(arr) <= limit.
GOOD: Non-admin users receive 403 from analytics endpoints (verified in test_non_admin_blocked).
GOOD: /api/users/{user_id}/posts requires auth (returns 401/403 unauth) - no staging bypass leaked.

MINOR: The Pit Shark beginner section already had a 'Pit Shark Step-Ups' entry (3 rounds 8/leg, 75s) pre-existing. The new intermediate entry shares the same name. Frontend keys workouts by name within an intensity, so this is fine, but if a flat search is ever used across intensities, name collision could be ambiguous. Not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: Data file validation 100% - E2E web testing not feasible for RN Expo on this fork

test_credentials.test_admin_pattern: Tests register a fresh TEST_admin_<ts> user via /api/auth/register then promote via DB is_admin=True flag (uses backwards-compat admin path). User cleaned up after the module run.
test_credentials.officialmoodapp: Admin via username allowlist (env ADMIN_ALLOWLIST default 'officialmoodapp'), but password unknown - did not use this path

seed_data_creation: Each test module run creates 2 throwaway TEST_-prefixed users (one admin, one non-admin). Admin user is removed in module teardown; non-admin user is left in DB (low impact).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the admin_token fixture pattern from test_admin_analytics_aggregation.py for any future admin-endpoint testing - it registers a fresh user and flips is_admin=True via direct Mongo write. BASE_URL resolves to https://free-tier-limit-2.preview.emergentagent.com from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Backend env APP_ENV=production - no staging shortcuts active.
